verdict.rationale: Docusign ships built-in AI features like AI-Assisted Review (chat-based review, redlining, drafting) and AI-Assisted Summary/Q&A, which let users delegate document-analysis tasks to an embedded assistant. However, this is scoped narrowly to contract review/summarization rather than general task delegation across the platform, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the assistant's real-world reliability. Missing for 10: broader agentic task delegation beyond document review, independent user validation of the AI assistant's quality.
